hero.subtitle: AI sleep technology born from Japanese care. Real-time vital signs, restful insights, and quiet peace of mind for the whole family.

about.title: We build sleep technology that respects rest.
about.lead: Headquartered with a Japanese design ethos, SleepTech engineers connected sleep devices that monitor without intruding — measuring vital signs through the surfaces you already trust: pads, beds, pillows.

pillars.title: Japanese craft
pillars.body: Hardware tuned for stillness. We obsess over fabric finish, sensor placement, and the subtleties of restful design.

pillars.title: AI-driven insight
pillars.body: Edge sensing fed into a private cloud. Heart rate variability, breath rate, body movement — translated into actionable nightly stories.

pillars.title: Family-shared
pillars.body: Invite siblings, partners, or caregivers. Receive alerts when a loved one's vitals stray from baseline. Privacy-first, always opt-in.

products.title: Built for life's quietest hours.
products.lead: A growing family of devices, all speaking the same SleepTech language.

yumepad.name: YumePad
yumepad.subtitle: Sleep Pad AI
yumepad.description: Slip YumePad under any mattress. Non-contact ballistocardiography captures heart rate variability, breath rate, body movement, and bed-presence — feeding a private AI that learns your rhythm and watches over your loved ones.
features: HRV + breath rate (BCG sensors, no skin contact)
Real-time push alerts for vital deviations
Offline edge processing — your data stays yours

smart_bed.name: Smart Bed
smart_bed.tagline: The bed that listens, adjusts, learns.
smart_bed.description: A full smart bedframe with zone-controlled climate, gentle elevation, and integrated YumePad sensing — choreographed to your sleep stages.

smart_pillow.name: Smart Pillow
smart_pillow.tagline: Snore detection. Posture nudge. Quiet presence.
smart_pillow.description: Memory-foam pillow with embedded microphone array and micro-haptics. Detects snoring, suggests gentle posture shifts, syncs with YumePad and Smart Bed.

testimonials.title: Loved by families across Asia.
testimonials.lead: Real stories from people who reclaimed peaceful nights with SleepTech.

items.quote: Within two weeks YumePad noticed my apnea before I did. The night-by-night story is what convinced my husband to see a doctor.
items.author: Aiko M.

items.quote: I live in Hanoi but my mother is in Hue. Family sharing means I can check her vitals every morning. It's like she's two streets away.
items.author: Linh P.

items.quote: The pad disappears under the mattress. No straps, no charging, no hassle. The app just tells me a clear story each morning.
items.author: Somchai T.

items.quote: Setup was five minutes. The Japanese attention to detail shows in every part — packaging, fabric, app rhythm. Premium without being loud.
items.author: Hiroshi K.
